slides.title: DataFlow AI

content.headline: AI-Powered Data Pipeline Automation
body: Seed Round Pitch
December 2025

slides.speaker_notes: Strong opening. State company name clearly and set the stage for the problem.

slides.title: The Problem

content.headline: Data Teams Are Drowning in Maintenance
body: 60% of time spent on manual pipeline fixes
$2.1M average annual cost per data team
Delays critical business insights by weeks
Scaling data infrastructure requires linear headcount growth

slides.speaker_notes: Paint the pain. Use the 60% stat prominently. Mention that this is based on industry research.

slides.title: The Solution

content.headline: Self-Healing Data Pipelines Powered by AI
body: Automatically detects and fixes pipeline failures
Optimizes performance without manual tuning
Scales infrastructure based on predicted demand
Reduces maintenance time by 80%
content.call_to_action: Let AI manage your data infrastructure

slides.speaker_notes: Contrast with the problem. Emphasize the 80% reduction. Show quick product demo if possible.

slides.title: How It Works

content.headline: Three Steps to Autonomous Data Operations
body: 1. Connect: Integrate with existing data sources in minutes
2. Learn: AI models your data patterns and dependencies
3. Automate: System handles monitoring, optimization, and scaling

slides.speaker_notes: Keep this simple. Focus on ease of implementation. Mention key integrations.

slides.title: Market Opportunity

content.headline: $12B TAM in Data Infrastructure Automation
body: 50,000+ companies with dedicated data teams
Average spend: $240K/year on data infrastructure
Growing 35% annually as data volumes explode

slides.speaker_notes: Show market is large and growing. Position within broader data infrastructure market.

slides.title: Traction

content.headline: Early Momentum with Enterprise Customers
body: 15 beta customers (5 paying)
$45K ARR with 30% MoM growth
Average 78% reduction in pipeline incidents
NPS score: 65

slides.speaker_notes: Emphasize quality of customers and product-market fit signals. Mention customer names if possible.
